chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sama'ah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Vinegar of the wine strengthens the gums, and kills the insects of the belly, and strengthens the intellect.
ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of vinegar of the wine according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the therapeutic benefits of vinegar derived from wine, noting its ability to strengthen the gums, eliminate intestinal parasites, and sharpen the intellect. This reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of integrating prophetic medicine (al-Tibb al-Nabawi) with practical health advice, emphasizing the purification and utility of common substances even when their source is permissible or transformed.
